entities.summary: Teodoro "Ted" Cruz Bacani Jr. is a Filipino Roman Catholic prelate of the Dominican Order who became the first bishop of Novaliches on January 16, 2003, serving until November 25, 2003. He previously served as Auxiliary Bishop of Manila from 1984 to 2002.
